title: Parable of the Good Samaritan
summary: Jesus told the story of a Samaritan who helped a wounded man when others passed by. The parable teaches that loving one's neighbor means showing mercy and compassion to anyone in need.
major_points: A man was attacked by robbers
A priest and Levite ignored him

title: Parable of the Prodigal Son
summary: Jesus told of a son who left his father, wasted his inheritance, and later returned in repentance. The father welcomed him back with joy, showing God's mercy toward sinners who repent.
major_points: The son asked for his inheritance
The father forgave and welcomed him

title: Parable of the Lost Sheep
summary: Jesus compared God's love to a shepherd who leaves ninety-nine sheep to find one that is lost.
major_points: He rejoices when it is found

title: Parable of the Sower
summary: Jesus taught that God's Word is like seed falling on different types of soil representing different responses of people's hearts.
